snippet.title: BrokenLore: ASCEND - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
BrokenLore: ASCEND launches on PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on January 7, 2027.

Climb to terrifying heights in a first-person psychological horror experience blending extreme climbing with supernatural horror inspired by the Rokurokubi, a terrifying yokai from Japanese folklore.

Follow two streamers as they attempt to climb a massive tower from the BrokenLore universe, officially created under license from Tokyo Tower.
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
